# Comparing median rent and new bonds lodged

This will compare median rent and new bonds lodged for all of VIC and NSW across:

1.  All properties
2.  1 bedroom
3.  2 bedroom
4.  3 bedroom
5.  4 bedroom

```{r}
state_plots <- plot_rent_and_new_bonds(data, treated = c("VIC"), controls = c("NSW", "QLD", "SA"))

purrr::iwalk(state_plots, function(plot, name) {
  file_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", name)

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path("C:/Users/David/Desktop/MicroEcon - Rent/RentAnalysis/Exhibits/Plots/", paste0(file_name, ".png")),
    plot = plot,
    width = 10,
    height = 12,
    dpi = 300
  )
})
```
